title: Add RAG agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples; docs site updates
author: Ava Chen
ci_status: pass (flaky test rerun required on node-examples)
description:
Motivation: Provide opinionated RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and concise quickstarts for developers who want to integrate agents with tool-calling and structured outputs. This PR bundles: 1) RAG agent templates (YAML + JSON) that show common retrieval + tool-calling patterns, 2) language-specific quickstarts and runnable examples (Python and Typescript) demonstrating tool registration and streaming responses, and 3) docs site updates (sidebar, landing page, and snippets) so the new content is discoverable.

Summary of changes: - docs/rag/quickstarts/index.md: new quickstart landing with overview, recommended prompts, and security notes. - docs/rag/templates/rag-agent-template.yaml: opinionated template for most customer flows (retriever + tool-calling + fallback). - examples/rag/python/quickstart.py: minimal runnable example showing embeddings + retrieval + agent orchestration. - examples/rag/typescript/quickstart.ts: same flow for TS with SDK usage and streaming handler. - examples/tools/http_tool.js: simple HTTP tool shim used in examples. - site/sidebars.json & site/config.js: include RAG section and quickstart landing. - docs/_includes/snippets/tool-calling.md: reusable snippet for docs and SDK samples.

Commits (high level): ["Add base RAG templates and agent examples", "Docs: add quickstart landing and sidebars", "Examples: python and ts runnable samples", "Examples: add http tool shim and test harness", "Fix: align doc headings and snippets"]

Testing: - Local doc build (Docusaurus) ✅ - Run python quickstart end-to-end against local dev retriever (mock) ✅ - TypeScript example ran with node 18 (needed a small fix to import paths; CI re-run passed) ✅ - Added unit test for http_tool shim (examples/tests/test_http_tool.js) ✅

Review notes and tradeoffs: - Templates intentionally keep retriever and tool interfaces abstract to avoid binding to a specific vector DB; an additional follow-up will add a connector example for pgvector (ENG-9347). - Kept examples minimal to reduce maintenance surface; we link to more advanced patterns in a future PR.

Checklist (typical docs PR): - [x] Add docs pages and sidebar entries - [x] Add runnable examples (Python / TS) - [x] Verify examples in CI and local runs - [x] Add snippet includes for reuse - [x] Add brief release notes entry

Review conversation (summary): - Priya Rao: "Can we add a short security note about handling user-supplied tool inputs?" — added note to index.md and tools README. - Diego Martinez: "Please add an example of function/tool calling with structured JSON output and schema validation." — added snippet and updated quickstart to show JSON schema validation. - Liam O'Neill: "Minor nit: use platform SDK 'client.stream' pattern rather than low-level fetch in the TS sample." — updated TS quickstart accordingly. - Author replies: addressed comments, refactored TS sample, added tests for tool shim.

CI and merges: - Initial CI run failed on node-examples lint (prettier) — fixed style and re-ran. - Flaky test (examples/test_http_tool) failed once on CI matrix; re-run succeeded. - Final CI state: all checks passed.

Merge: Squash-merged after approvals from Priya and Diego. Merge commit: 6a7b3f9.

Release notes (short): - Added RAG agent quickstarts (Python & TypeScript), opinionated RAG templates, and tool-calling examples; docs site updated to include RAG quickstarts.
